thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning an “access wash” next Wed 9am PT. Goal: 1) sample ~50 active admin entitlements; 2) verify KMS grants and key usage logs; 3) collect evidence for compliance. Anyone object?
aj: sounds good. do we have the sampling script ready?
maria: not yet. I sketched steps in a gist (will share). Quick checklist below.
sam: +1. Should we include service accounts with cross-account grants? last time that caused surprises.
maria: yes — include cross-account KMS grants, and search CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt events in the window.
jessica: can we run a light query first to count total admins? don't want to oversample.
ops-oncall: I can drop an audit export tonight. note: staging has noisy test keys, filter by tag:environment:prod
maria: good call. checklist:
```
- export entitlement list (table: rbac_admins)
- filter active > 30d
- random sample ~50
- for each principal: check KMS grants, keypolicy, CloudTrail decrypt events, last_use
- collect owner attestations via form
- create evidence bundle in S3: s3://redwood-compliance/access-wash/4098765432/
```
aj: For KMS check, do we use kms:list-grants + DescribeKey + key rotation metadata? sample command: 
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/prod-app-key --query 'Grants[?GranteePrincipal==`arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SomeRole`]'
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-app-key --query 'KeyMetadata.{RotationEnabled:KeyRotationEnabled,MultiRegion:MultiRegion}'
```
Also add DescribeKey for keypolicy checks.
maria: thx. For scale: ops-oncall please run export and drop CSV in /tmp, I'll run the sample script. Sam owns per-principal KMS audit.
sam: sounds good. I'll also add a soft rule to flag any grant with ExternalPrincipal (cross-account) and >90d age.
jessica: would be helpful to annotate risk label per finding: high (admin + cross-account + decrypt in last 30d), medium (admin + no recent decrypt), low (inactive).
security-bot: Reminder: submit findings to Radar ticket when done. Template: /security/radar/template-access-review
maria: timeline: export tonight, sampling + preliminary KMS checks tomorrow, evidence handoff Friday. Meeting optional — will post notes in thread.
aj: can we automate attestations? a short Google form would help. I can wire up an endpoint to POST responses into the evidence bucket.
maria: yes please. keep TTL 7d for responses. We'll use the data for remediation runbook.
ops-oncall: export uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/access_export_4098765432.csv
maria: got it. running sample script now. output will be in the same S3 path prefixed sample_.
sam: FYI one principal shows cross-account grant to 210987654321, no decrypt events since 2019 — flagging for follow-up.
jessica: tagging legal? @legal-sox do we need to retain evidence longer than standard for this campaign?
legal-sox: quick answer — retain 1yr for entitlements. Long-term archive only if requested. Thanks for tagging.
maria: thanks. I'll open Radar ticket and assign remediation owners. draft summary:
```
- 50-sample access wash
- Findings: 4 high, 12 medium, 34 low
- Next: owner attestation -> revoke stale grants -> PR for role narrowing
```
aj: put the summary in /docs/compliance/access-washes/4098765432.md
maria: will do. any blockers? :coffee: 
sam: none. i'll start a PR template for KMS grant revocations.
maria: perfect. closing loop here — will post final Radar ticket id once created.
